Name Key MCertificate Element_{Key MCertificate}_{Key MCertificate Element} Comment Service of the certificate sub module to access certificate elements. The certificate configuration defines how the certificate submodule can find the element, e.g. by providing the object identifier (OID). This function is used to retrieve this information if only one element is assigned to the respective OID. Index=0 accesses the first element. If only one data element is available, the function returns "1".
